title: रानी की वाव मिट्टी में दबकर भी नई कैसे रही? 🏛️
cover_text: सदियों दबी रानी की वाव, फिर भी *सलामत*!

cover.prompt: A huge close-up of a flawless ancient sandstone goddess face with a carved crown rising out of dark packed silt, crisp intricate details filling the lower two-thirds of the frame, warm side light, plain dark black empty area at the top

source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre (Rani-ki-Vav); Archaeological Survey of India

fact_check.weak: payoff is mild; the 'new' hook slightly overstates (parts of the structure did collapse, and ASI work began before the 1980s), but nothing is factually wrong

hook_score.why: Strong specifics (thousand years, no scratch), visible, clear gap; wording slightly list-like and 'कैसे' tacked on.
hook_score.was: सदियों तक मिट्टी में दबा कुआँ, फिर भी बिल्कुल नया क्यों?
